errors.text_span: die jeweils die Werte der Schuldenquote Zentralstaat (rechte y-Achse) darstellen

The description does not correctly and completely describe the per-panel y-axes: it misstates the right subplot's left-axis range and does not clearly distinguish the two subplot-specific left axes.
